text:
I had a deep conversation with a friend about what is the most useful thing AI has created/done for either of us.

For my private life, AI helped me to diagnose and root caused a running toilet, and avoided the high cost of a plumber. It even help to select the replacement parts and how to replace them.

Of course, on the tech side, AI is helping me build a healthcare company.

What was yours?
title: Ask HN: What is the most useful thing AI has done for you?
